changelog: v1.0.2 — Added README.md with overview, features, dependencies, installation, command reference, API, and credits. Standardized GitHub repo metadata (badges, dynamic version pull, MIT license, Qbox required). v1.0.1 — Race fix for client cache. Added client export RefreshTier() so other distortionz_* scripts can force a known-fresh tier fetch on demand. Cache also auto-refreshes on playerSpawned so it's warm earlier. v1.0.0 — Initial release.
